name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
storyline:
In a faraway, skyborne land...

Perched high above the surface realms lies the lovely floating continent of Jupiterno. Princess Lucia, hailed as a "True Wizard," rules in the king’s stead.

A True Wizard’s power far surpasses that of ordinary wizards. If the average wizard is an ant, a True Wizard is the queen ant—possessing innate magic that operates on an entirely different scale.

Princess Lucia, a rare prodigy said to appear only once among billions, wields an almost divine might. Yet when her heart grows dark, she imposes tyranny across the land, slaughtering anyone who dares defy her.

Amid this reign of terror, Luna—celebrated as one of the most brilliant wizards in all of Jupiterno—finally decides to confront Lucia. Encouraged by her allies, Luna takes a stand against the dreaded True Wizard.

To bring down Princess Lucia and her allied nations, Luna and her companions form a resistance, vowing to challenge the royal capital head-on!
summary: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!
